_help: Rust + Cargo preset. Gates run in its target's dir (the repo root for a single-app config). Air-gapped: vendor crates (cargo vendor) and point .cargo/config.toml at the vendored/offline source; then builds need no network.
session_budget_hint: A slice should fit one agent session: ~1 vertical behavior, < ~10 files touched, tests included. If it won't fit in your head, split it.
